component: Historical versioned toolchain task and libotr fetch consumers

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The historical patch adds a separately named linux64-clang-21 task and directs only the two macOS libotr fetch lists to it. The existing Clang22 task still owns the generic linux64-clang alias. The libotr script consumes the fetched clang/bin directory through target-prefixed compiler names. This is a scoped configuration/consumer relationship, not a project-wide downgrade or proof of a successful compiler/library build; the accepted later config uses the generic task again.
title: The libotr compiler fallback pins two macOS tasks without changing the generic Clang22 alias
